label: Bible Study
prompt: The _____ declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
verse: The heavens declare the glory of God; and the firmament sheweth his handywork.
note: David's sky-watching psalm — the stars preach a sermon every night without saying a word.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things _____. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.
verse: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.
note: From the throne itself: 'I make all things new.' Not all new things — all things new.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a _____ unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
verse: And the children of Israel went into the midst of the sea upon the dry ground: and the waters were a wall unto them on their right hand, and on their left.
note: Israel crossed the Red Sea on dry ground, the waters standing as a wall on their right hand and on their left.

label: Deep Water
prompt: I have planted, Apollos _____; but God gave the increase.
verse: I have planted, Apollos watered; but God gave the increase.
note: Corinth was splitting into preacher fan clubs; Paul says preachers are just gardeners — the growth is all God's.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his _____, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
verse: Ye are the salt of the earth: but if the salt have lost his savour, wherewith shall it be salted? it is thenceforth good for nothing, but to be cast out, and to be trodden under foot of men.
note: Salt that has lost its 'savour' — KJV spelling, British u and all — is good for nothing but the road.
